name: Mr. House, President and CEO
oracle_text:
Whenever you roll a 4 or higher, create a 3/3 colorless Robot artifact creature token. If you rolled 6 or higher, instead create that token and a Treasure token.
{4}, {T}: Roll a six-sided die plus an additional six-sided die for each mana from Treasures spent to activate this ability.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you roll a 4 or higher, create a 3/3 colorless Robot artifact creature token. If you rolled 6 or higher, instead create that token and a Treasure token.
{4}, {T}: Roll a six-sided die plus an additional six-sided die for each mana from Treasures spent to activate this ability.

needs.what: a trigger event fired once per die a player rolls (controller: you), carrying the rolled result so a trigger filter/condition can ask 'rolled >= 4' and the effect can branch on 'rolled >= 6'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has wins_coin_flip but nothing for dice; the roll_dice op and the `rolled` value exist, but `rolled` reads an op's own `as` binding, not a roll made by some other source

needs.what: a 3/3 colorless Robot artifact creature token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has robot_villain_2_2_c (2/2 Robot Villain) and golem_3_3_c_artifact (3/3 Golem); neither is a 3/3 Robot

needs.what: a value counting mana from sources matching a filter (here Treasures) spent to pay THIS activated ability's cost, so roll_dice count can be 1 + that number
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_spent_from reads mana_spent_origins of the cast object (source_oid), i.e. what was spent casting the permanent, not what was spent on an activation
